title: The eye as lamp and love as light
english: The eye is the lamp of the body (Matthew 6:22). So if your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light; but if your eye is evil, your whole body will be dark. But if the light in you is darkness, how great is the darkness (Matthew 6:23)? The sound eye is sincere love, through which, when the whole body is enlightened, it brings forth through the outward actions the same things as the things thought within. The evil eye, on the other hand, is pretended love, which is also called hypocrisy, and through it the whole body of a person is darkened.
